name: Graphify
summary: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.

installSummary: Use the official project links for current install and setup instructions. Generated pages do not mirror commands automatically.
highlights: Type /graphify in your AI coding assistant and it maps your entire project — code, docs, PDFs, images, videos — into a knowledge graph you can query instead of grepping through files.
Works in Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot Chat, Aider, OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Trae, Hermes, Kimi Code, Kiro, Pi, and Google Antigravity.
Step 2 — register the skill with your AI assistant:
On platforms that support payload-bearing hooks (Claude Code, Gemini CLI), a hook fires automatically before search-style tool calls and nudges your assistant toward the graph path.
On the others (Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, etc.), the persistent instruction files (AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/, etc.) provide the same query-first guidance.
GRAPHREPORT.md is still available for broad architecture review.
God nodes — the most-connected concepts in your project.
